verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly reference 'multi-language SDK support' for the embedding API, and community evidence confirms a JS/Node SDK (npm package) is actively used alongside the documented Python-first APIs seen throughout the docs. This shows official SDKs exist and are usable for building AI-native apps, though the evidence pack doesn't enumerate all supported languages or link directly to SDK reference pages. Missing for 10: an explicit SDK reference/installation page listing all official languages (Python, JS/TS, Rust) and independent hands-on confirmation beyond one HN comment.
